For over 35 years, Al Ryum Group has delivered landscape, infrastructure, buildings and MEP projects trusted by governments and developers across the UAE and the GCC.

Al Ryum Group is an industry leader in construction and innovation across the built environment, specialising in the design, engineering, construction, development and infrastructure financing of major real estate projects across the Middle East. 01 · UAE
UAE

Al Ryum Group's UAE operations span Abu Dhabi, Dubai and the Northern Emirates, with multi-decade relationships across federal, municipal and sovereign clients. Marquee engagements include DMT (Dept. of Municipalities & Transport), MASDAR, ADNOC, TDIC, Aldar, MUBADALA, Abu Dhabi Municipality, DAMAC, Meraas, EMAAR, Nakheel, TECOM, FEWA and the Crown Prince Courts of Abu Dhabi and Ajman — across giga-project landscape, public realm, parks, cultural, hospitality, theme park and infrastructure delivery.

FLAGSHIP
Zayed National Museum — Landscaping, Irrigation & Car Park, Abu Dhabi (Dept. of Culture & Tourism)
02 · Qatar
Qatar

Al Ryum's Doha team delivers premium urban and tourism infrastructure for public-sector clients across Qatar — from coastal parks and large-scale streetscape renewals to flagship Lusail developments, supporting the country's long-term infrastructure pipeline.

FLAGSHIP
Lusail Boulevard Streetscape, Doha
03 · Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia

Al Ryum's Saudi operations anchor the Kingdom's giga-project delivery — NEOM, Red Sea, Qiddiya and Diriyah — bringing three decades of GCC landscape and infrastructure expertise to Vision 2030 and working alongside leading Saudi developers and PIF-backed programmes.

FLAGSHIP
NEOM Trojena Mountain Resort, Tabuk
04 · Iraq
Iraq

Al Ryum's Iraq operations deliver landscape, infrastructure and construction works in Baghdad, including the Faruk Medical Center and Al Zawraa Park, reflecting the Group's ability to mobilise at scale in complex, high-growth markets.

FLAGSHIP
Faruk Medical Center & Al Zawraa Park, Baghdad
05 · Jordan
Jordan

Al Ryum's Jordan presence is anchored by the Aqqaba Golf Course in Aqaba, extending the Group's golf and leisure development expertise to the Red Sea coast.

OUR STORY
From a handful of engineers to a regional powerhouse 

Al Ryum Contracting & General Transport Co. LLC was founded in 1990 by Chairman Mr. Ara Khanoyan and a small team of engineers in Abu Dhabi — driven by a vision to bring world-class landscaping and construction expertise to the UAE.

Today, operating under the Al Ryum banner in Abu Dhabi and ARCO in Dubai, the group spans Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, HVAC, Landscaping, Theming and Infrastructure delivery across nine countries.

Our consistent track record is backed by 5,000 staff, hundreds of specialist engineers, an extensive heavy equipment fleet, dedicated plant nurseries and a large metal fabrication workshop — all under one group, all working for you.

OUR PURPOSE
Mission & Vision
🎯
Our Mission

To be the preferred contractor and construction partner in the region — managing, enhancing and innovating on quality engineered services with the primary objective of achieving client satisfaction and merit recognition at all times, while continuously adding long-term value to every stakeholder.

🔭
Our Vision

To be the most trusted and innovative construction group in the Middle East — setting the benchmark for technical excellence, sustainable development and human-centred project delivery. Every structure we create stands as a testament to quality, integrity and craftsmanship.

"

At Al Ryum Group, our strength lies not just in the structures we build, but in the relationships we forge. Every project is a promise — a commitment to our clients, our communities, and to the generations who will live and work within the spaces we create. Our vision is to continue raising the bar for construction excellence across the region and beyond.

R

Rafael Khanoyan

Chief Executive Officer, Al Ryum Group

WHAT DRIVES US
Our Core Values

These principles guide every decision we make, every project we undertake, and every relationship we build — from the boardroom to the build site.

Building trust, one project at a time.

Quality Excellence

Triple-certified under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and OHSAS 18001:2007 — our quality systems ensure every project meets the most demanding international benchmarks.

People-First Culture

Our 5,000+ professionals are our greatest asset. We invest in their development, safety and wellbeing — because exceptional people build exceptional structures.

Regional Leadership

From the UAE to Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman and Iraq — our deep regional roots and decade-spanning relationships give us an unmatched edge across GCC markets.

Sustainable Future

We engineer green into every project — transforming arid landscapes into thriving environments, reducing carbon footprints, and building in harmony with nature.

End-to-End Delivery

Design. Engineer. Build. Maintain. We are your single trusted partner across the full project lifecycle — eliminating coordination gaps and keeping your vision intact.

Safety First

Zero-harm is not a target — it is our standard. Rigorous HSE protocols protect every worker on every site, every single day across all our operations.

Experts in every dimension of the built environment

Our Services

Seven integrated divisions delivering the built environment across the GCC — from concept through to operation.

SCROLL
WHAT WE DO
One integrated group, seven disciplines

Design, plants, plant, procurement, construction and maintenance held inside one company. That is what removes the coordination gaps between them.

01 · ENGINEERING & DESIGN
Masterplanning, civil, structural, electrical, mechanical and landscape design under one roof.

Our in-house engineers take a scheme from concept and feasibility through detailed design to construction drawings and method statements — BIM models, coordinated services and landscape architecture resolved together, so the drawing set and the site are never disagreeing.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
ENGINEERING & DESIGN
NURSERIES & PLANT PRODUCTION
02 · NURSERIES & PLANT PRODUCTION
Plants propagated, hardened and acclimatised for the Gulf before they ever reach site.

Large-scale nursery facilities produce the trees, palms, shrubs and groundcovers our contracts need. Species are selected for arid conditions, raised under controlled irrigation and acclimatised before delivery — which is why our planting establishes instead of failing.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
03 · OPERATIONS & MAINTENANCE
Landscapes kept alive and safe long after handover.

Horticultural maintenance, irrigation management, sports turf care and asset inspection across parks, golf courses, public realm and highways — scheduled programmes with the same crews, spare parts and standards that built the scheme.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
OPERATIONS & MAINTENANCE
PLANT, MACHINERY & VEHICLES
04 · PLANT, MACHINERY & VEHICLES
Our own fleet, maintained in-house, on site when the programme says so.

Excavators, loaders, telescopic handlers, tippers, water bowsers and specialist landscape plant run from our own yard and workshop. Owning the fleet removes the hire chain from the critical path and keeps earthworks, planting and maintenance on the dates promised.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
05 · PROCUREMENT
Materials sourced, qualified and delivered without stalling the programme.

Supplier qualification, contract negotiation and logistics for everything from bulk aggregates and paving to live plants and irrigation components — with warehousing and staged deliveries matched to the construction sequence rather than the supplier's convenience.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
PROCUREMENT
PROJECT & CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT
06 · PROJECT & CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT
One accountable team from first survey to final handover.

Planning, coordination, quality assurance, testing and commissioning across disciplines — survey and stakeholder approvals, documentation, training and warranty support. All works delivered to authority and contract requirements, with a single point of responsibility.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
07 · STEEL FABRICATION
Structural steel and architectural metalwork, fabricated and installed by the same team.

Custom structural steel, balustrades, pergolas, gates and architectural features fabricated in our workshop and installed on our own sites — dimensional accuracy checked before it ships, finishes applied in controlled conditions rather than on the scaffold.

SEE THIS CAPABILITY →
STEEL FABRICATION

ABOUT

Design-led delivery for complex built-environment projects

Al Ryum Group's engineering and design capabilities span civil, structural, electrical, mechanical and landscaping disciplines. We translate ambitious client visions into buildable, measurable designs using BIM, 3D modelling and value-engineering principles.

From masterplanning and concept design to detailed construction drawings and method statements, our in-house engineers and design partners deliver coordinated solutions that reduce risk, control cost and accelerate programme timelines across the UAE and GCC.

SERVICES

What we deliver
Concept & Feasibility

Early-stage masterplanning, site analysis and feasibility studies that set the right foundation for every project.

Detailed Engineering

Civil, structural, MEP and irrigation designs prepared in BIM-enabled environments for accuracy and clash-free construction.

Landscape Architecture

Botanically rich, water-wise landscape designs tailored to the desert climate and client identity.

Design Management

Coordination of consultants, authorities and contractors to keep design intent intact through construction.

CAPABILITIES

What makes us different
BIM-enabled design coordination
Civil, structural, MEP and irrigation engineering
Landscape architecture and planting design
Value engineering and constructability reviews
Authority approvals and permitting support
As-built documentation and handover
